intro: The old clockmaker left everything to whichever apprentice could finish the last clock, and the workshop has held its breath since the will was read. It has no face, no hands, and fourteen drawers, and the apprentices move around it as if it might wake. Sawdust banks against the benches, and the smell of oil and hot brass lingers long after the lamps are banked. The foreman keeps a cabinet beside the lathe with pigeonholes cut to take one part each, so a misplaced wheel or spring is a sin rather than a mistake. Some apprentices whisper that the drawers are waiting for someone to know what belongs where, and that the inheritance will not care how clever they have been.
echo: The Black Forest clockmakers taught a bird to announce the hour.

puzzles.title: Escapement
puzzles.flavor: Everything in its place, and nothing twice. The tape was spooled back onto the wrong reel.

hints: Black squares are spaces. Which two- and three-letter words fit, using only the letters each column allows?
